02 / Side projects

Personal projects

01 / iPhone & iPad

Tellus

A world map and travel guide built with SwiftUI and MapKit. Pick a country for travel advice, visa requirements, weather, and local time. Switch on map layers to explore the activity and infrastructure around it.

  • SwiftUI
  • MapKit
  • Geospatial data
View Tellus on GitHub ↗

Inside Tellus

Country guides

Explore a country’s geography, energy, and economy alongside practical guidance on entry, health, and local laws. Country figures show their observation year and source.

Live flights and infrastructure

Follow aircraft in the visible map area, trace submarine cables to their landing points, or zoom in to see power lines and substations.

Earth at night

See the day–night boundary as it moves across the map. Tellus calculates it on the device and overlays the latest available NASA Black Marble imagery.

GPS interference

Browse daily GPSJAM maps that show areas where aircraft reported reduced navigation accuracy.

Globe illustration uses Natural Earth country boundaries.
